skill.name: setup-pre-commit
skill.description: Set up Husky pre-commit hooks with lint-staged (Prettier), type checking, and tests in the current repo. Use when user wants to add pre-commit hooks, set up Husky, configure lint-staged, or add commit-time formatting/typechecking/testing.
skill.summary: Configure Husky hooks that format staged files and run available type checks and tests before each commit.
skill.author: mattpocock

security_audit.summary: All 22 static findings are false positives caused by Markdown backticks and fenced examples, not Ruby backtick execution or injectable command construction. One semantic risk remains: the workflow instructs the agent to stage every changed file, which can include unrelated or sensitive work.

remediation.issue: The commit step stages all changed and created files, including changes unrelated to this setup.
remediation.suggestion: Stage only files changed by the setup, show the staged diff, and request user confirmation before committing.

content.value_statement: Manual formatting and validation allow avoidable issues into commits. This skill configures Husky, lint-staged, Prettier, type checks, and tests for consistent local checks.
actual_capabilities: Detects npm, pnpm, Yarn, or Bun from repository lock files.
Installs Husky, lint-staged, and Prettier as development dependencies.
Creates a Husky hook for staged formatting, type checks, and tests.
Creates lint-staged configuration that formats supported staged files.
Adds a default Prettier configuration only when one is missing.
Verifies required files and runs lint-staged as a smoke test.
limitations: Requires a JavaScript repository with package.json and a supported package manager.
Omits type checking or tests when matching package scripts are unavailable.
Uses fixed Prettier defaults and does not infer an existing team style.
The workflow can stage unrelated changes unless the commit step is reviewed.

use_cases.title: Protect Feature Commits
use_cases.description: Add formatting and validation checks before new application code enters project history.

use_cases.title: Standardize Team Repositories
use_cases.description: Apply consistent local commit checks across an existing JavaScript project.

use_cases.title: Modernize Project Tooling
use_cases.description: Add Husky and lint-staged to a maintained repository without replacing its existing Prettier settings.

prompt_templates.title: Basic Setup
prompt_templates.prompt: Set up pre-commit checks in this repository. Detect the package manager and explain each changed file before committing.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use for a project without existing commit hooks.

prompt_templates.title: Preserve Existing Style
prompt_templates.prompt: Add Husky and lint-staged. Keep the existing Prettier configuration and use only typecheck or test scripts already present.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use when the project already defines formatting rules.

prompt_templates.title: Diagnose and Configure
prompt_templates.prompt: Inspect this repository for existing hooks and scripts. Configure compatible pre-commit checks, report omitted checks, and run the documented verification.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use when the repository has partial tooling.

prompt_templates.title: Review Before Commit
prompt_templates.prompt: Plan a Husky v9 setup using the detected package manager. Minimize hook duration, test lint-staged, show the staged diff, and request commit confirmation.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use for a controlled setup in a repository with active work.

output_examples.input: Set up pre-commit checks in this npm project.
output: Installed the three development tools and initialized Husky.
Added staged formatting and available validation scripts.
Ran lint-staged successfully and displayed the files ready to commit.

output_examples.input: Add hooks without changing our current Prettier rules.
output_examples.output: Kept the existing Prettier configuration, created the Husky hook and lint-staged settings, then verified staged formatting.

output_examples.input: Configure this pnpm project, which has no test script.
output_examples.output: Detected pnpm, configured formatting and type checking, omitted tests, and reported the missing test script.

best_practices: Review existing hooks, package scripts, and formatting settings before making changes.
Run lint-staged and inspect the staged diff before creating the setup commit.
Keep pre-commit checks fast enough for regular local use.
anti_patterns: Do not replace an existing Prettier configuration with generic defaults.
Do not add typecheck or test commands when package.json lacks those scripts.
Do not stage unrelated repository changes with the setup files.

faq.question: Which package managers are supported?
faq.answer: The workflow detects npm, pnpm, Yarn, and Bun from their lock files. It defaults to npm when detection is unclear.

faq.question: Will it replace my Prettier configuration?
faq.answer: No. It creates a default configuration only when the repository has no Prettier configuration.

faq.question: What happens when typecheck or test scripts are missing?
faq.answer: The missing command is omitted from the hook, and the skill reports that omission.

faq.question: What runs before each commit?
faq.answer: The hook runs lint-staged first, then available typecheck and test scripts.

faq.question: Does the workflow create a commit?
faq.answer: Yes. The documented workflow stages changes and commits them, so review the staged file list before approval.

faq.question: Which Husky version does the hook format target?
faq.answer: The instructions target Husky version 9 or later, which does not require a shebang in hook files.
